features: TheANT Flora Bud Digital Body Weight Weighing Scaleis designed for accurate and convenient everyday weight monitoring at home. Equipped with ahigh-precision strain sensor, it supports measurements of up to180kgwith50g graduation, providing reliable readings for regular body weight tracking.

Built with a durable5mm tempered glass platformand strong ABS construction, the Flora Bud combines stability with a sleek and elegant appearance. Its26 × 26cm weighing platformprovides a comfortable and stable surface, while the silk-screen finish adds a refined look.

The large60 × 26mm LCD displayprovides clear weight readings, whileautomatic weight detection, auto reset and auto power-offmake weighing quick and effortless. These functions also help improve battery efficiency during everyday use.

For added reliability, the scale features anO-Ld overload indicatorandlow-battery alertto help protect the device and keep you informed of its operating status. Simply install the included2 AAA batteries, place the scale on a hard, flat surface and step onto the platform to begin weighing.
The package includes theANT Flora Bud Digital Weighing Scale, 2 AAA batteries and user manual, backed by a40-month warrantyfor long-term peace of mind.
